title: WTKO-CNN: Deep Learning Reveals Sequence Motifs Distinguishing Wild-Type and Knockout ATAC-seq Peaks
abstract: arXiv:2605.24034v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chromatin regulators can alter transcriptional programs by modifying the accessibility of regulatory DNA elements. Understanding how regulatory sequences differ between wild-type (WT) and knockout (KO) conditions is crucial for deciphering transcriptional control. Here, we applied a convolutional neural network, \textbf{WTKO-CNN} with an attention mechanism to classify DNA sequences as WT or KO, achieving high predictive performance. To interpret the model, we generated saliency maps to identify nucleotide positions most influential for the classification decision. From these high-saliency regions, we extracted and clustered k-mers, enabling de novo motif discovery. Sequence logos and consensus motifs derived from the CNN filters revealed biologically meaningful patterns, which are further validated using MEME, TOMTOM, and HOMER against known transcription factor binding sites. translated_title: WTKO-CNN：深度学习揭示区分野生型与敲除型ATAC-seq峰的序列基序
translated_abstract: 摘要：染色质调控因子可以通过改变调控性DNA元件的可及性来改变转录程序。理解野生型（WT）与敲除型（KO）条件下调控序列的差异对于解读转录调控机制至关重要。在此，我们应用了一种带有注意力机制的卷积神经网络——WTKO-CNN，对DNA序列进行WT或KO的分类，实现了较高的预测性能。为了解释模型，我们生成了显著性图，以识别对分类决策影响最大的核苷酸位置。从这些高显著性区域中，我们提取并聚类了k-mer，从而实现了从头基序发现。由CNN滤波器导出的序列标识图和一致性基序揭示了具有生物学意义的模式，并进一步使用MEME、TOMTOM和HOMER与已知的转录因子结合位点进行了验证。我们的分析识别了与转录相关的基序……
tldr: 本研究开发了带注意力机制的卷积神经网络WTKO-CNN来区分野生型与敲除型ATAC-seq序列，并通过显著性图和k-mer聚类实现从头基序发现，揭示了可区分两种条件的关键转录因子结合基序。
en_tdlr: This study developed WTKO-CNN, an attention-based convolutional neural network that classifies wild-type versus knockout ATAC-seq sequences, and leverages saliency maps and k-mer clustering for de novo motif discovery, revealing key transcription factor binding motifs distinguishing the two conditions.
